content: लाङ्गलम् [लङ्ग् कलच् पृषो˚ वृद्धिः भुवि गच्छति <ls>Uṇ. 1. 105</ls>] .²1 A plough; लाङ्गलग्लपितग्रीवा मुसलैर्भिन्नमस्तकाः <ls>Rām. 7. 7. 47</ls>. .²2 A plough-shaped beam or timber. .²3 The palm tree. .²4 The membrum virile. .²5 A kind of flower. .²6 A particular appearance of the moon. .²7 A kind of timber (used in building houses). .²8 A pole for gathering fruit from a tree; <ls>Rām.</ls> .{@-लः@} A kind of rice. .{@-ला@} The cocoa-nut tree.
